How to read these numbers

Weighted to the population

Each figure is weighted so it stands for all adults (or all businesses, for MSME surveys) in the country, not only the people interviewed.

Strands versus usage

A strand puts each person in one place on a ladder, from most formal to excluded, so it adds up to 100%. Usage counts every channel a person uses, so it can add up to more than 100%.

Comparing years

Questions and definitions change between survey rounds, so treat changes over time as a guide. The survey report explains each round's method.
